choices: Above what size should a file stay out of the page?

A 2 MB file becomes about 2.67 MB inside the page, because writing it in as text adds a third. Five such files still fit under the 16 MB publish limit. Today's largest picture is 194 KB, so every current picture goes inside.
Fewer files stay out, but three 5 MB files written in come to 20 MB, which is over the 16 MB publish limit.
Pictures go in until the page reaches 10 MB, and the rest stay in the folder. It adapts to how many pictures a page has, but which pictures stay out depends on their order.
A per-file limit is simple to check, and 2 MB leaves room for several large pictures on one page under the publish limit.
Should videos always stay out of the page, whatever their size?
Videos stay in the folder even when small, as your answer named them. Pages stay quick to open.
A short clip under the limit goes inside the page like a picture.
You named videos as the case for the folder, so treating them as a kind rather than a size follows your answer most closely.
